heap.method: Production build; genuine SPA Library/Rexonance round trips; unchanged performance.timeOrigin; three forced GCs after each return; native heap retaining paths plus WeakRefs for main and every descendant Node, including text and comments.

offDocumentResources.note: Chromium detachedness=2 also counts deliberate off-document resources, not just leaked former DOM. Every remaining retaining path was inspected; histogram equality is asserted on all five returns.

heap.preloadProbe: 11 independent cleanup variants: fixing src to the already-decoded currentSrc before removing srcset/sizes released the native listener with zero extra image requests; clearing all attributes did not. The successful path is covered by the final heap assertions.

layout.extreme: Both forms and all three transition layers use matching contain geometry; physical draw scale <= 1.
layout.world: Entire poster stays within all four frame edges; physical draw scale <= 1; no extra transform or scroll-settle enlargement.
layout.finalStage: End-card underline centre differs from title centre by at most 0.016 CSS pixels.

navigation.phoneNote: The pre-existing narrow-screen CSS hides the nav at 390px; state and rotation to visible landscape were checked.
